flags.message: Salience-version mismatch: all three candidates (gemini-baseline, codex-baseline, claude-baseline) froze band=baseline under salience_version=sal-v3, but the committed metrics/statpack.md renders its 'Segment base rate by salience band' table under sal-v4. Per the evaluate prompt, segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score were omitted and base_rate_basis left null on every candidate; no cell was relabelled terminal. Note for the maintainer: metrics/statpack.json carries sal-v3 alt_segments for every Term OT2017-OT2025 and the baseline band's risk-set figures are identical under sal-v3 and sal-v4 (pooled reached rate 5.02%, n=12,720), so the harness's version-pinned pool can resolve what the rendered-table rule cannot. The candidates' quoted anchor (6.55%, n~13,163) came from the table as rendered on 2026-08-16; the current pack pools to 5.02%, a vintage difference, not an arithmetic error.

Arrival-moment cell provisioned from a snapshot dated 2026-08-16, 26 days after docketing (2026-07-21). The snapshot already carried the linked stay application 26A145 (filed Jul 24, denied by Justice Kagan Aug 3, refiled Aug 6) and an Aug 11 supplemental brief; two candidates used the single-Justice stay denial as a negative signal and one explicitly set it aside. This is legitimate forward information, not leakage (distribution_count was still 0), but it is a docket-acquired signal inside a cell defined as 'before any docket-acquired signal exists'. Separately, the docket's petition entry is dated Dec 30 2025 while DocketedDate is July 21, 2026 and the PDF path is dated 2026-07-24; one candidate noted the inconsistency.
